monogr.title: Five Millennium Catalog of Solar Eclipses: 1701 to 1800

Espenak, Fred, Index for Five Millennium Catalog of Solar Eclipses (Online – http://eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov/SEcat5/SE1701-1800.html bei NASA eclipse web site).
